crossRefs.note: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

translations.web: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,
translations.bsb: For she leaves her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand.
translations.kjv: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
translations.asv: For she leaveth her eggs on the earth, And warmeth them in the dust,
